function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH aug_avg AS (SELECT AVG(fx_rate) AS avg_fx FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line WHERE currency='USD' AND period='2026-08'),
sep_lines AS (SELECT qty, unit_price_orig, fx_rate FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line WHERE currency='USD' AND period='2026-09')
SELECT SUM(qty * unit_price_orig * (fx_rate - aug_avg.avg_fx)) AS fx_effect_cad
FROM sep_lines, aug_avg","purpose":"Compute FX effect on CAD cost for Sep USD purchase lines using Aug average fx rate"}
